title: Scrambled Label Match
brief: A warehouse scanner sometimes reads the letters of a product code out of order when a label is creased. Before flagging a mismatch, the inventory service checks whether the scanned code could simply be the expected code with its letters shuffled.
Implement isRearrangedCode(s, t), where s is the expected code and t is the scanned code, and return true if t uses exactly the same letters as s, rearranged in any order, and false otherwise.
